decisions.reason: The multifunctional handle has shown no results beyond a mention, and with A, B and D already pruned, uncertainty about it remains, but keeping a single model in an established handle range costs little and it fits the accessibility direction, so the option stays open for another year.
The design award and dedicated page signal that much of this collection's value has been confirmed, which justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
A finish option draws on in-house finishing capability at minimal holding cost and adds variety across the coordinated families, so it is worth keeping while its demand becomes clearer.
